summary: Iteration 139 Phase 3 verification (Security Checkpoint Kiosk follow-ups): 14 new backend tests + 96 regression tests all pass (110/110 green). UI smoke confirms LiveCheckpointWidget on dashboard, Scan ID row inside MemberForm, and source-level presence of receipt-override testids on the Security Checkpoint console.

issues: Date of Birth field uses native browser date picker (mm/dd/yyyy) instead of shadcn Calendar component. Pre-existing; not introduced by iter139.

tests_executed.regression_suite: 96/96 passed across test_smoke_recent_modules.py + test_iteration115_pass2_volunteers_unify.py + test_iteration116_activity_pdf_export.py + test_iteration90_module_access.py + test_iteration91_security_checkpoint.py + test_iteration138_ocr_exit_ws.py
tests_executed.ui_playwright: Dashboard widget renders (1 row visible with auto-refresh 4s); Add Person dialog shows Scan ID button + hidden file-input with correct testids; /security-checkpoint pairing screen loads cleanly

endpoints_verified: POST /api/ocr/id — 401 unauth, 400 bad MIME / empty / oversize, 200 with shape {name,date_of_birth,id_number,raw_text,confidence,language_hint}, language echo 'sw' & default 'en'

POST /api/security/checkpoint/receipt-override — 401 without security session, 400 missing fields, 404 unknown event_id, 401 bad PIN, 200 happy with decision='approved' + supervisor_override audit (supervisor_id/name/role/reason/at/original_decision), 400 re-override (not denied), no _id leak
GET /api/security/dashboard/checkpoints — 401 unauth, 200 admin returns list with paired_devices/recent_events≤5/today_approved/today_denied/holding_ids, pairing_pin stripped, no _id leak
critical_code_review_comments: DashboardPage.jsx role-gate uses a hard-coded array ['admin','system_admin','Executive Director','Adviser','Director'] — duplicated logic from backend's role policy. Consider centralising into a hasDirectorAccess() helper to avoid drift if RBAC roles change.

LiveCheckpointWidget polls every 4s with setInterval; no exponential backoff on transient errors. With many open tabs this is fine, but consider visibility-API gating (only poll when document.visibilityState==='visible') to save backend load.
MemberForm OCR pre-fill only fills empty fields (good), but there's no explicit UI hint to the user that already-typed values were preserved beyond the toast — minor UX nit, not a bug.
security_checkpoint.py is 896 lines — getting close to the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting OCR helpers, override, and dashboard endpoints into separate sub-routers next iteration.
Receipt override returns the full updated event JSON — confirmed no Mongo _id leakage. Good.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on the smoke-checks performed (dashboard widget + MemberForm scan-id row + checkpoint page load)

seed_data_creation: Each test class creates TEST_-prefixed checkpoints/products/sales and cleans them up via fixture teardown. No residual seed data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter139 brings the total backend regression to 110 tests (96 baseline + 14 new). The 14 new tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration139_ocr_override_dashboard.py and rely on (a) PIL-rendered JPEG, (b) admin pin='9999', (c) a transient checkpoint they create+pair+destroy. They run in ~7s. The frontend LiveCheckpointWidget hides when zero checkpoints exist (correct behaviour) — when testing UI, create a checkpoint first or it will appear missing. Receipt-override testids only render after a denied receipt scan; verified at source level (lines 837/852/858/862 of SecurityCheckpointPage.jsx). DashboardPage.jsx widget is gated to admin/system_admin/Executive Director/Adviser/Director via hard-coded array — flag if RBAC list changes.
